text: I went to many clinics for my second round of orthodontic treatment before finding this one. I had my treatment done at this branch. The doctor is lovely; she's a professor who specializes in both metal and clear aligners. I chose Invisalign because the clinic was having a promotion at the time. Dr. Puen oversaw my case and created the treatment plan herself, without using any machines to calculate the treatment. It only took 5 months, and now I'll be able to remove my braces. The doctor, the assistants, and the staff at the counter are all wonderful. I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor is incredibly skilled and understood my needs. I'm so happy with my experience! 🥰🥰
